title: ProviderTargetAttributionReturnV2 — HISTORICAL COMPLETE58 host projection shape, not worker delivery
description: WITHDRAWN as the worker delivery interface (COMPLETE58). A caller-built envelope of TargetAttributionV2 cannot be the provider invocation: FactCandidateV1 already carries opaque encoded resolvedTarget, and planId/sourceFactId/producerClosure do not exist until the host mints fact2. CURRENT delivery is OccupancyCompanionV1 on negotiated FactBatchV3 (native/occupancy-companion.schema.v1.json, native/fact-batch.schema.v3.json). Host bind_worker_occupancy mechanically projects this V2 shape after mint. This document remains the captured-record join shape and the internal-fault registry. NOT a digest-domain. NOT a protocol3 frame. origin is a fault-observation field, not an admit blessing.

planId.description: Must equal the Plan whose Analyze stage minted the named facts.

producerClosure.description: Must equal each named fact's producerClosure. Named closure MUST be Plan-selected kind=provider. This is the wrapper that encoded compiler-native resolution into SubjectIdV1 payloads; occupancy mapping is the second output of that same encoding.

stageOrdinal.description: Exact execution-plan stage ordinal whose Analyze minted the facts. Joins hostCapture.stageReceipts[ordinal]. Not a protocol3 phase.

records.description: Zero or more TargetAttributionV2 records. Each item MUST admit as foundation/target-attribution.schema.v2.json. Strict unique utf-8 order by sourceFactId. Duplicate sourceFactId refuses. Empty array is a present incomplete return (all omitted facts occupancy-unknown except exact-id ephemeral), distinct from a missing envelope.

x-opensip-return-law.standing: COMPLETE58 adapter-envelope is historical and is not worker delivery. CURRENT channel is negotiated FactBatchV3 occupancy companions plus host mechanical projection. Protocol3 frame name FactBatch is unchanged; payload version is capability-gated by token target-attribution-v2. Historical FactBatchV2/FactCandidateV1 stay closed when the token is absent.

boundary.compilerWorkerTransport: FactCandidateV1 unchanged. When Hello negotiates target-attribution-v2, FactBatch payload is FactBatchV3 carrying occupancyCompanions associated by candidateOrdinal BEFORE fact2 exists. When the token is absent, FactBatchV2 remains and occupancy is unknown except exact-id ephemeral.
boundary.providerWrapper: The language wrapper RUNS IN THE WORKER process, before FactBatch emit, while compiler-native resolution is still in memory. It encodes opaque SubjectIdV1 into FactCandidateV1.canonicalRelationPayload AND emits OccupancyCompanionV1 in the same batch. It does not run after host fact2 mint. There is no post-FactBatch shared table.
boundary.hostAdapter: Owning entry bind_worker_occupancy. Decodes payload, mints fact2, binds companion.candidateOrdinal to that mint, fills planId/sourceFactId/producerClosure from retained Plan/execution-plan stage spec/view membership. Captures projected TargetAttributionV2. Does not take origin as an admit parameter.

invocation.name: bind_worker_occupancy
invocation.when: After this producer's Analyze-stage fact2 identities are minted from THIS FactBatch's candidates. Before attach_host_capture / close_run.

inputs.batch: FactBatchV3 or null. Null with token absent is lawful omission. V3 without token refuses.
inputs.negotiated_tokens: Hello/HelloAck token array (trusted host observation of negotiation)
inputs.stage_specs: map of stageSpecDigest → stage spec carrying producerClosure
inputs.views: retained views of this producer; sourceFactId MUST be a member
inputs.minted_by_ordinal: host mint map candidateOrdinal → fact2, verified against this batch's candidates

output.records: the admitted TargetAttributionV2 list (empty when omitted or empty records)
output.hostDerivedRefs: canonical-set of {domain:target-attribution, digest:raw-sha256-of-C(record)} — empty when omitted
output.blobs: map digest → C(record) bytes for those refs. Envelope itself is never a blob/selectedRefs member

notInputs: arbitrary host filesystem or package-manager data claimed as provider attestation

order.atomic: admit every record then capture every record, or refuse the whole envelope. No partial hostDerivedRefs from a refused envelope

joins: envelope.planId equals invocation planId and each record.planId
envelope.producerClosure equals invocation producerClosure, each record.producerClosure, and each named fact.producerClosure
envelope.stageOrdinal equals invocation stageOrdinal and names the execution-plan stage that minted the facts
each record.sourceFactId is a member of invocation facts (PROVIDER_RETURN_UNKNOWN_FACT / TARGET_ATTRIBUTION_FACT_NOT_IN_PLAN otherwise)

each named fact is on a resolved binary-id rung (registry targetNativeIdField present and fact.resolution in endpointTargetRungs); syntactic-only facts MUST be omitted (TARGET_ATTRIBUTION_FIELD_NOT_ON_RUNG if included)
each record admits as TargetAttributionV2 including inventory first-party join and ephemeral-identity conflict law

missingAndIncomplete.missingEnvelope: lawful. No target-attribution refs are captured from this producer/stage. Occupancy unknown except exact-id ephemeral first-party. NOT required-output-pointer-omitted. NOT a protocol violation.
missingAndIncomplete.presentEmptyOrPartial: lawful. Omitted facts of this producer remain occupancy unknown except exact-id ephemeral. A present envelope is not required to cover every minted fact.
missingAndIncomplete.extraRecord: a record whose sourceFactId is not in this producer's minted facts refuses

errorHandling.atomicRefuse: any envelope or record refusal captures nothing from this envelope
errorHandling.internalKeysRemainInternal: TARGET_ATTRIBUTION_* and PROVIDER_RETURN_* stay internal diagnostic keys in retained diagnostic bytes. They are not DomainDetailCode members and are not D9 codes.
errorHandling.publicRoute: existing evaluator-fault observation {condition, origin}. Provider-emitted malformed records/envelope: condition=input-schema-invalid, origin=provider-return → operational-failed PROVIDER.PROTOCOL_VIOLATION faultCause=provider-protocol detail=EVALUATION.INPUT_REFUSED. Provider-emitted join/conflict: condition=input-join-invalid, origin=provider-return → same public detail. Host-invented mapping: origin=host-internal → operational-failed SYSTEM.OUTCOME.ILLEGAL_STATE faultCause=host-invariant detail=HOST.INVARIANT_VIOLATED. Exact routes: evaluator-fault-observation.schema.v3.json x-opensip-routes. LIVE D9 successor-artifact remains a future host obligation and is not discharged by this route.
not: alias of an internal key as a public code

producerSupply.authority: Only the fact-producing Plan-selected provider wrapper that encoded the payload may attest occupancy. Host capture is custody. Exact-id ephemeral projection remains host-derived and is never written as TargetAttributionV2.
producerSupply.sharedTable: One intended mapping for every language mode that can emit resolved binary-id facts. Portable occupancy identity (file LogicalPath / packageName+packageManifestPath / symbol SubjectIdV1) stays distinct from opaque payload SubjectIdV1.

ts-tsconfig / js-allowjs / js-synthesize.wrapper: TypeScript/JavaScript semantic wrapper. After fact2 mint, emit one V2 record per minted resolved-target/resolved-binding/resolved-callee/to/reachable fact that the compiler-native resolution table can attribute, or omit that fact (unknown).
ts-tsconfig / js-allowjs / js-synthesize.fileFirstParty: compiler resolved a first-party program file whose inventory nativeSubjectId is LogicalPath P: occupancy=first-party, kind=file, evaluationNativeId=P, logicalPath=null. evaluationNativeId is the inventory spelling, NOT the opaque payload string (except the accidental C15 case where inventory N already equals SubjectIdV1 and therefore P equals targetNativeId).
ts-tsconfig / js-allowjs / js-synthesize.fileExternal: compiler resolved outside first-party inventory: occupancy=external, kind=file, evaluationNativeId=null, logicalPath MAY be a non-authoritative hint
ts-tsconfig / js-allowjs / js-synthesize.packageFirstParty: compiler resolved a first-party package: occupancy=first-party, kind=package, evaluationNativeId=packageName, packageManifestPath=inventory row.path, logicalPath=null
ts-tsconfig / js-allowjs / js-synthesize.packageExternal: compiler resolved an external package: occupancy=external, kind=package, evaluationNativeId=null, packageManifestPath=query coordinate (not a first-party join), logicalPath=null
ts-tsconfig / js-allowjs / js-synthesize.symbol: exact-id. Wrapper MAY omit (ephemeral first-party when payload native id uniquely equals inventory native id) or identity-map evaluationNativeId=targetNativeId
ts-tsconfig / js-allowjs / js-synthesize.unknown: compiler could not decide: omit the record or emit occupancy=unknown with evaluationNativeId=null
ts-tsconfig / js-allowjs / js-synthesize.syntacticRungs: omit. imports@syntactic-specifier, references@syntactic-name-match, calls@syntactic-callee-name have no occupancy mapping

rust-cargo / rust-cargo-prepared.worker: rust-semantic protocol major 3. Unchanged frames including FactBatch and CoverageV3.
rust-cargo / rust-cargo-prepared.wrapper: Rust semantic wrapper. Same envelope and occupancy law. rustc/cargo resolved path vs package fills the compiler-native resolution table during the same encoding that writes SubjectIdV1 payloads.
rust-cargo / rust-cargo-prepared.fileFirstParty: first-party crate source file in inventory: occupancy=first-party, kind=file, evaluationNativeId=inventory LogicalPath
rust-cargo / rust-cargo-prepared.packageFirstParty: first-party workspace package: occupancy=first-party, kind=package, evaluationNativeId=packageName, packageManifestPath=row.path
rust-cargo / rust-cargo-prepared.packageExternal: crates.io / external crate: occupancy=external, kind=package, packageManifestPath=query coordinate

syntax-only.wrapper: syntax-only provider. MUST omit this envelope, or omit every file/package occupancy record.
syntax-only.symbols: control-flow@syntactic and reachability may identity-map or omit; MUST NOT invent file/package occupancy from specifier text
syntax-only.never: do not advertise resolved imports/file/package occupancy from syntax-only

clone-candidate.wrapper: clone/candidate producers are not occupancy-mapping producers of resolved binary-id facts. MUST omit this envelope. Candidate member IDs are never evaluation-subject identity.

never: host parse of SubjectIdV1 namespace to invent kind/occupancy/evaluationNativeId
treat host filesystem walk, package-manager metadata, or cache as provider attestation
add a protocol3 or typescript-semantic frame named TargetAttribution
add target-attribution to a view-only stage outputDomains
write ephemeral exact-id projection as this envelope or as TargetAttributionV2

ephemeralIdentityConflict.law: If ephemeral exact-id occupancy is first-party identity I_eph AND sidecar occupancy is first-party identity I_sc AND I_eph ≠ I_sc, refuse TARGET_ATTRIBUTION_EPHEMERAL_IDENTITY_CONFLICT. Independently known identity cannot be silently rewritten by a contradictory provider mapping. Occupancy identity is (kind, evaluationNativeId) for file/symbol and (kind, evaluationNativeId, packageManifestPath) for package.
ephemeralIdentityConflict.reproducibleOperand: Inventory contains file nativeSubjectId=file:src/a.ts (SubjectIdV1 spelling that is also a LogicalPath) AND file nativeSubjectId=src/b.ts. Payload resolvedTarget exactly equals file:src/a.ts, so ephemeral I_eph is first-party file:src/a.ts. Sidecar occupancy=first-party evaluationNativeId=src/b.ts joins the other inventory row. Join of kind/exists succeeds; identity disagrees. Refuse. Do not overwrite ephemeral nativeId with src/b.ts.
ephemeralIdentityConflict.agreement: Sidecar first-party identity equal to I_eph is admitted (sidecar+ephemeral). Sidecar occupancy=unknown keeps ephemeral. Sidecar occupancy=external while ephemeral is first-party remains TARGET_ATTRIBUTION_EXTERNAL_CONTRADICTS_FIRST_PARTY.

x-opensip-new-internal-faults.standing: Internal diagnostic keys. They are not DomainDetailCode members and are not D9 codes. Public standing is the EXISTING evaluator-fault typed boundary: observation {condition, origin} in evaluator-fault-observation.schema.v3.json x-opensip-routes. Provider-return origin uses EVALUATION.INPUT_REFUSED plus PROVIDER.PROTOCOL_VIOLATION. Host-internal origin uses HOST.INVARIANT_VIOLATED. LIVE D9 successor-artifact remains a future host obligation and is not discharged.

publicRoute.diagnosticBytes: unmodified owner diagnostic artifact; MUST contain the internal key
